proofs.outputs.Proofs.MuonBest.best_gradient:
by
  classical
  let X : ℕ → Mat p.m p.n := OracleTemplate.SimplifiedMuon.trajectory (sourceInput p) G
  have hstep (k : ℕ) : outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1) =
      outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step p (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G k) (G (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G k).point) := by
    simp only [outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
  have hpoint (st : outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.State p) :
      (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step p st (G st.point)).point = st.point - stepSize p • orthogonalize (G st.point) := by
    dsimp only [outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step]
    split <;> rfl
  have hX (k : ℕ) : X (k + 1) = X k - stepSize p • orthogonalize (G (X k)) := by
    exact Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _
  have hpnt : ∀ k, (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G k).point = X k := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => rw [hstep, hpoint, ih, hX]
  have hbest : ∀ k,
      (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).seen = true ∧
      (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).score = nuclearNorm (G (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).best) ∧
      (∃ j ≤ k, (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).best = X j) ∧
      ∀ j ≤ k, (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).score ≤ nuclearNorm (G (X j)) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      simp [outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt, initial, outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step, X, OracleTemplate.SimplifiedMuon.trajectory, sourceInput]
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨hseen, hscore, hmem, hmin⟩ := ih
      by_cases hc : nuclearNorm (G (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).point) ≤ (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G (k + 1)).score
      · rw [hstep (k + 1)]
        simp only [outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step, hseen, Bool.true_eq_false, false_or, hc, ite_true]
        refine ⟨True.intro, True.intro, ⟨k + 1, le_rfl, hpnt (k + 1)⟩, ?_⟩
        intro j hj
        by_cases hjlast : j = k + 1
        · subst j
          rw [hpnt]
        · exact hc.trans (hmin j (by omega))
      · rw [hstep (k + 1)]
        simp only [outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step, hseen, Bool.true_eq_false, false_or, hc, ite_false]
        refine ⟨True.intro, hscore, ?_, ?_⟩
        · obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := hmem
          exact ⟨j, hj.trans (Nat.le_succ k), heq⟩
        · intro j hj
          by_cases hjlast : j = k + 1
          · subst j
            rw [← hpnt (k + 1)]
            exact (lt_of_not_ge hc).le
          · exact hmin j (by omega)
  have hlast := hbest (K - 1)
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hK] at hlast
  obtain ⟨_, hscore, _, hmin⟩ := hlast
  have hsum : (K : ℝ) * nuclearNorm (G (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G K).best) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin K, nuclearNorm (G (X j.val)) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _j : Fin K, nuclearNorm (G (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G K).best) := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => by
        rw [← hscore]
        exact hmin j.val (by have := j.isLt; omega)
  have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < K := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < K by omega)
  refine ⟨hpnt K, ?_⟩
  change nuclearNorm (G (outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stateAt p G K).best) ≤ (1 / (K : ℝ)) * ∑ j : Fin K, nuclearNorm (G (X j.val))
  rw [one_div_mul_eq_div]
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hKpos).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hsum)

proofs.outputs.Proofs.MuonSelection.execute_ran:
by
  let s0 : OracleTemplate.Muon.State q := (muon q).initial ()
  let F : OracleTemplate.Muon.State q × ℕ → OracleTemplate.Muon.State q × ℕ :=
    fun sc => (OracleTemplate.Muon.step q sc.1 (g sc.1.point (tape sc.2)), sc.2 + 1)
  let F' : (OracleTemplate.Muon.State q × Fin (N + 1)) × ℕ →
      (OracleTemplate.Muon.State q × Fin (N + 1)) × ℕ :=
    fun sc => ((OracleTemplate.Muon.step q sc.1.1 (g sc.1.1.point (tape sc.2)), sc.1.2), sc.2 + 1)
  have hit : ∀ k, F'^[k] ((s0, j), 0) = (((F^[k] (s0, 0)).1, j), (F^[k] (s0, 0)).2) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih]
  have hj : j.val < q.T + 1 := by have := j.isLt; omega
  have hsource := congrFun (execute_muon q hB P g () tape) ⟨j.val, hj⟩
  erw [execute_indexed] at hsource
  change (F^[q.T * q.B] (s0, 0)).1.iterates j.val = (trajectory q g tape j.val).2.1 at hsource
  erw [execute_indexed]
  change (F'^[q.T * q.B] ((s0, j), 0)).1.1.iterates
    (F'^[q.T * q.B] ((s0, j), 0)).1.2.val = (trajectory q g tape j.val).2.1
  rw [hit]
  exact hsource

proofs.outputs.Proofs.MuonTuning.tuning_bounds:
by
  have hr : (0 : ℝ) < (min p.m p.n : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < min p.m p.n by omega)
  have hthreshold : 0 < threshold p C := by
    dsimp only [threshold]
    positivity
  have hceilpos : 0 < ⌈threshold p C⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr hthreshold
  have hK : 1 ≤ horizon p C :=
    (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hceilpos).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
  have hKpos : (0 : ℝ) < horizon p C := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < horizon p C from hK)
  have hceil : threshold p C ≤ (horizon p C : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (⌈threshold p C⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
      _ ≤ _ := by simp only [horizon, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]; linarith
  have ha : 0 < 1 - momentum p C ∧ 1 - momentum p C ≤ 1 := by
    simp only [momentum, sub_sub_cancel]
    by_cases hzero : p.σ = 0
    · simp only [hzero, ite_true]
      norm_num
    · simp only [hzero, ite_false]
      have hσpos : 0 < p.σ := lt_of_le_of_ne hσ (Ne.symm hzero)
      constructor
      · apply lt_min
        · apply div_pos
          · exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos hC hΔ)
          · exact mul_pos hσpos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (mul_pos hr hKpos))
        · norm_num
      · exact min_le_right _ _
  refine ⟨by linarith [ha.2], by linarith [ha.1], ?_, hK, hceil⟩
  exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos (mul_pos ha.1 hΔ) (mul_pos hKpos hC))
